metaTitle: How to Use a Propane Fire Pit Safely
description: Use a propane fire pit safely at camp with 10-foot clearances, leak tests, correct lighting and shutdown steps, fuel run times and campground fire rules.
directAnswer: Place the pit outdoors on a level non-combustible surface at least 10 feet from tents and RVs, leak-test connections with soapy water, never leave it unattended, and shut the cylinder valve first when done. Check fire restrictions first.
